summary: Make terminal attachment regression tests portable and independently buildable

replay.detail: Test configuration only; no replay changes.

rules.detail: No rule, checkpoint or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Attachment tests configure read timeouts before discarding stale streams, avoiding macOS socket-option errors after closure while preserving EOF assertions. The TUI dev-dependency explicitly enables daemon test support so its tests compile without another workspace package enabling that feature. Production behavior and dependencies are unchanged.
